messages.subject: TinnR with R3.2.4 revised
parts:
I recently updated R to 3.2.4 revised.  When I try to install package TinnR, I get the following:
Warning message:
package 'TinnR' is not available (for R version 3.2.4 Revised) 
Error in library(TinnR) : there is no package called 'TinnR'

Anyone else have this problem?

messages.author: 18092322a527b40b
messages.subject: Re: TinnR with R3.2.4 revised
parts:
Hello,

I am just migrating to Windows 10 and testing Tinn-R and R version 3.2.4 (revised and patched).
I confirm the bug and I need to see what is happening.

For while the best soluction is:
1. Close Tinn-R if running;
2. Start Rgui.exe whithout Tinn-R;
3. In R:
> install.packages('devtools')

> library(devtools)

> install_github("jcfaria/TinnRcom/TinnRcom")

It should install the TinnRcom packages and all dependencies (formatR, svMisc and svSocket)!

4. Close Rgui.exe
5. Start Tinn-R and R (Rterm or Rgui).

Please, let me know the results.
